items.title: Do you take walk-ins?
items.body: Yes. Join the walk-in queue from the website, or ask the host at the door.

items.title: Is there parking?
items.body: There is street parking nearby and a small car park behind the building.

items.title: Cancellation policy
items.body: Cancel up to two hours before your booking at no charge.

items.title: About the chef
items.body: Our executive chef trained in Lisbon and Lyon and builds the menu around the weekly market.

items.title: Dietary needs
items.body: The menu marks vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free dishes, and lists every allergen.
